correctness.rationale: Disjointness of rational fiber point sets and the genus-one Hasse lower bound give the one-blocking sharp upper bound, with the blocking-set size six established by complete 13-point incidence enumeration. A complete 29524-form enumeration gives exactly 936 blocking cubics without rational line factors; exact PGL3(F3)-orbit enumeration and modular Groebner charts prove geometric smoothness. Exhausting all complementary cubics with exact chart tests yields 936 accepted normalized generators, partitioning three-to-one into 312 pencils per blocking cubic and four certified point-count profiles; multiplication gives 292032. The executable verifier was run successfully and is embedded.

value.rationale: The problem is naturally motivated by blocking versus nonblocking fibers in algebraic pencils. This is an exact sharp bound and complete enumeration of all four-smooth-member ternary cubic pencils with a blocking member, including four distinct fiber-cardinality distributions and a reproducible example, not merely a restatement or routine arithmetic consequence of the known single-cubic orbit census.
